# {{ ibm_power_server_title }} Block CSI Driver Operator {#persistent-storage-csi-ibm-powervs-block}

You can provision and manage {{ ibm_power_server_name }} Block storage in OpenShift Container Platform by using the Container Storage Interface (CSI) Driver Operator and driver, which provide dynamic volume provisioning.
